name: Pebbulk
notes: Pebbulk: a grumpy grey boulder with a mossy cap and stubby feet. Type ROCK. Moves: Rock Throw (A), Harden (B: 3 s of defense 50) and Rock Slide (R). Walks at 80 % speed: its move 1 (Rock Throw) reaches 3 tiles, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. Its moves hit 10 % softer than their power says (power 90 %), whether it is the player or a wild one, in every mode. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: PEBBULK
